gaps: Every breath-one spend was written as the counterparty's registration of the exercise: the target reads the exploit, the record holds the novelty, the enemy infers the source, the opponent sees the showdown, the body and the population adapt. Pressing on the quarter-end discount showed the register can be an expectation rather than knowledge; pressing on the engineer's hidden buffer showed the register can sit above the holder rather than across from it; and pressing on the informed trade showed an exercise that registers itself, spent in proportion and by the holder's own wish. This produced the changed question for breath two: what must register the exercise for the spend to occur, and can the holder ration the spend by choosing the register, so that a quiet or partial exercise exists.
accepted: Never asked: an advantage that consists in a count of zero is spent whole by the first exercise, whatever its size, since 'I have never asked you for anything' is a sentence with one use, as the founder who telephones the customer's chief executive directly once, the supplier that has never invoked force majeure, the ally who calls in the debt from the war; the condition spent is the clean record, which becomes a count of one, so that the second ask is priced against the first rather than against the record; it does not regenerate, since no length of not asking again returns the count to zero, though a counterparty's turnover can lose the count; the mark is that the sentence can no longer be said, and a counterparty who hears 'I rarely ask' knows it has been said before; not status-conversions' Introducer's tab, where each introduction is billed to the introducer at a rate, since here the first exercise carries almost the whole price and the tenth almost none, and the bill is the asker's own.

Sword that drops the shield: an advantage held as a protection is spent when the protected matter is used as a weapon, as the defendant who pleads advice of counsel waives privilege over the advice and the file behind it, and the witness who testifies on a subject opens that subject to cross-examination; the condition spent is that the protected matter was never put in issue by its own holder, and it becomes discoverable material in the counterparty's hands; it does not regenerate for that subject, and the holder often learns it was spent only at the motion to compel, weeks after the pleading that spent it; the mark is the waiver ruling and the production that follows; not power-trades' Queen for a day, where the exclusivity of a fact is traded for immunity in a letter struck before the fact is spoken, since here nothing is traded and the spend is a side effect of an exercise the holder priced as free.

Ruling that prices the patent: an advantage held in the uncertainty of a right's scope is spent by testing it, as the unlitigated patent that licensees pay to avoid finding out about, and the untested termination clause the counterparty settles rather than construes; the condition spent is the uncertainty, which becomes a claim-construction order or a judgment, and even the win narrows, since a court that upholds a claim says what it covers and every future defendant reads the boundary; it does not regenerate for that right, though a continuation application can grow a new uncertain claim beside it; the mark is the order itself and a licensing rate that steps on the day it issues, up or down; not ghost-leverages' threat of suit under a statute already repealed, a dead power still obeyed, since here the power is live and the exercise reveals its exact size to everyone who will ever face it.

Novelty in the book: an advantage held in an opponent's unpreparedness is spent by one exercise in a venue that records, as the chess player's prepared novelty that enters every database the evening it is played and the trick play that is on the opposing staff's film by Monday; the condition spent is the idea's absence from the record, which becomes theory every future opponent has read; it does not regenerate for that idea, and the holder's stock regenerates only by preparing the next; the mark is the annotation in the database and, after it, a second showing that meets a prepared reply; the holder's control is the venue, since the same idea in an unrecorded game is not spent, which is why novelties are kept for the opponent and the round that matter; not Zero-day, spent by the target's own forensic reading, since here the target may never understand the idea and it is spent anyway by whoever reads the record.

Zero-day: an advantage held in a maker's ignorance of a flaw is spent by the exploit's use, because the exploit carries its own description onto the target's machine, where the target or its vendor can read it; the condition spent is the maker's ignorance, which becomes a patch, and the exploit's price falls from the price of an unknown flaw to the price of an unpatched population; it does not regenerate for that flaw, and the holder's stock regenerates only by finding another; the mark is the advisory and the patch date, and the trade's word for a spent exploit is burned; not Burned source, where the exercise spends the condition only if the action cannot be otherwise explained, since here the exercise is the description and no cover is available, only a target chosen for not looking.

Burned source: an advantage held in a stream of the counterparty's own communications is spent by any action that only the stream could explain, as the wartime convoy attacks based on decrypts that were preceded by a reconnaissance aircraft so the enemy could credit the aircraft, and the informant whose reports must not be acted on so exactly that only he could have told; the condition spent is the counterparty's belief that its channel is secure, which becomes a rekeyed cipher and a hunt for the leak; it does not regenerate for that source; the mark is the counterparty's procedure changing, which the holder sees as the stream going dark; the holder's control is explicability, so the exercise is rationed not by count but by whether a cover for each action exists, and the most valuable action is the one that cannot be covered; not Novelty in the book, spent by a record anyone can read, since here the register is the counterparty's own inference and an action that looks like luck leaves the source intact.

Image shown down: an advantage held in a counterparty's model of the holder is spent only if the exercise is revealed, as the tight player's bluff, which wins because of the image and destroys the image at showdown; the condition spent is the model, which becomes its opposite, a loose image that the counterparty can exploit and the holder can exploit in the other direction; it regenerates with a new table, or with time and a run of exercises that confirm the old model; the mark is the calls that come afterward; the holder can fold before the showdown and the counterparty's own fold keeps the image intact, so exercise without spend is available and the spend is made by the counterparty's decision to look; not Zero-day, where the revelation is in the target's hands, since here it is in the holder's hands until the last card.

Flaming datum: an advantage held in the counterparty's ignorance of where the holder is is spent by any exercise that can be traced, as the submarine whose torpedo hands the escorts a bearing, the sniper whose shot marks the hide, and the quiet acquirer whose first bid tells the market what it wants; the condition spent is the unknown position, which becomes a known one and a search centered on it; it regenerates by moving, at the cost of time and of the exposure the move itself risks, which is why the doctrine is one shot and relocate; the mark is the return fire, or in the market the price of everything the acquirer is now known to want; not Burned source, where what is spent is the counterparty's channel and no move restores it, since here the holder regenerates the condition by its own act.

Tolerance: an advantage held in a receiver's naivety is spent by the dose, as the receptor that desensitizes under a repeated agonist so the same dose does less, and the audience that stops flinching at the alarm; the condition spent is the receiver's sensitivity, which becomes tolerance and, when the dose stops, an overshoot in the other direction; it regenerates with abstinence, on the receiver's clock and not the holder's; the mark is the escalating dose, which is the only number the holder can see; not Resistance bred, spent across a population by selection, since here the receiver is one body and the condition comes back if left alone; not stamina, since the thing spent is not the holder's supply but the target's response.

Resistance bred: an advantage over a population is spent by selection, as the antibiotic that leaves the survivors, the pesticide, and the phishing template that survives only in the inboxes trained on it; the condition spent is the population's susceptibility, which becomes a resistant population and a drug moved to the reserve list; it regenerates only where resistance carries a fitness cost and the exercise is withdrawn long enough, and sometimes not at all; the mark is the rising concentration needed for the same effect, measured across the population rather than the patient; the condition is a commons, so any holder's exercise spends every holder's condition and one holder's restraint preserves nothing, which is why stewardship is a rule and not a choice; not risk-rebound-effects' The antibiotic bequest, which names the successor risk the mitigation breeds, since here the point is the shape of the spend, that the condition is shared and the regeneration is on the pathogen's clock.

Exception cited back: an advantage held in discretion, the power to grant or refuse, is spent by the grant, because the grant is the next petitioner's precedent, as the end-of-quarter discount that teaches the buyer when to buy, the covenant breach waived three times that the borrower pleads as course of dealing, and the exception for one employee that becomes the policy; the condition spent is the unbound choice, which becomes a schedule the counterparty can read; it regenerates only by a distinguishing that costs the holder credibility or by a counterparty who has not seen the record; the mark is the anti-waiver clause, the paper by which lenders try to grant without spending, and the quarter-end spike in bookings; the spend reaches only the counterparty that saw the grant unless a carrier moves the record, a most-favored-nation clause, a union, a reporter; not deal-deaths' Concession-made option, where a concession reveals a need and manufactures the other side's alternative, since here the grant reveals nothing and binds by being repeated.

Lever that tags the hand: an advantage held in a counterparty's presumption that one would not use a power against it is spent by using it, as the employee who takes the counteroffer and is thereafter a flight risk, and the investor who blocks the sale under a protective provision and is thereafter the investor who blocks sales; the condition spent is the presumption of alignment, which becomes a tag; it regenerates only with the turnover of the people who remember; the mark is the succession plan started quietly, the reference call that goes badly, the allocation not offered; adds to power-trades' Veto sold as an improbability the exercise price, which is not the deal blocked but the deals not offered, paid in the market where the power was allocated; not status-conversions' Cashing out, where standing is sold for money, since here standing is spent as a side effect of an exercise that was not a sale.

Tier above: an advantage held in a signal's rarity is spent by each use, as the priority flag, the urgent subject line, the superlative in the reference letter, and the honorific; the condition spent is the base rate against which the signal is read, which becomes a higher base rate and then decoration; it regenerates only by minting a rank above, the severity zero above the severity one, the new honorific, the word coined to replace the euphemism that has taken on its referent; the mark is the count of tiers, which records how many times the signal has been spent as a tree's rings record winters, an instance of clocks-that-are-not-clocks' Ratchet count; not risk-rebound-effects' The alarm fatigue, the sensitivity raised until the true alarm arrives pre-ignored, since here the spender is each sender and the regeneration is by a new tier that starts rare and is spent the same way.

residue.item: Told once: a secret's exclusivity is spent by one telling, whether or not the hearer acts on it.
residue.why: Rejected as a standalone: power-trades' Queen for a day already holds exclusivity consumed by the telling, and the map would restate it; what survives is Sword that drops the shield, where the telling is a use the holder priced as free and the spend is a protection rather than an exclusivity.

residue.item: Cried wolf: the alarm's advantage is spent by each alarm that resolves without the wolf.
residue.why: Merged into Tier above as its first case and its regeneration; risk-rebound-effects' The alarm fatigue holds the risk shape, and what the map adds is the sender as spender and the new tier as regeneration.

residue.item: Euphemism treadmill: the polite word is spent by contact with its referent and replaced by a new one.
residue.why: Merged into Tier above as the regeneration case in language; the spend by contamination rather than by frequency was not distinct enough to earn a second item, and is kept in the residue as a possible split.

residue.item: Political capital: a mandate spent on a controversial act.
residue.why: Rejected: money by another name, the shallow class the brief excludes; what is consumed is the advantage's own supply and no condition beside it. Lever that tags the hand keeps the part that is a mechanism, the presumption of alignment spent by exercise.

residue.item: Leased strike's atrophy: the strike not run for twenty years returns as a threat nobody believes.
residue.why: Rejected: out of type by direction, since it is spent by disuse; kept as the boundary case with Walk on record, an advantage that regenerates by exercise, on the same side of the fence.

residue.item: Sanction that teaches the target: the dependency used as a lever is rerouted by the target.
residue.why: Held for breath two: the target's reroute is a walkaway built by the holder's own hand, and it needed the threshold shape before it could be placed.

gate: declared modality, recognizable distinction, defensible seriation and conditional relations
limits: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy or a partition; a real raise, suit, campaign, or trade spends several of these conditions at once, and the list makes no claim to cover every kind.

The seriation is an itinerary of how much exercise spends the condition and what must register the exercise, not a ranking of value, danger, or reversibility; the map edges are conditional authored claims, and the convergence, passages, fork, and step they draw are interpretations.

The illustrative cases (advice-of-counsel waiver, decrypt cover flights, order slicing, anti-Morris-Trust rules, generic patent challenges, counteroffers) are simplified to expose one mechanism each and are not claims about specific transactions, cases, or operations; the exploit and intelligence items describe mechanisms, not practices to adopt.

Spending the advantage's own supply is out: money, stamina, ammunition, a one-use option, since what is consumed is the advantage and not a condition beside it; power-trades' Leased strike, a power spent by disuse, is out by direction, since here the spend is by exercise; and an advantage that becomes unattractive after use, the tactic that now embarrasses, is out unless a condition of its working was consumed. The exhaustion of a right by its first sale, in which the seller is paid and the buyer holds a unit the seller no longer controls, is in type and absent; it would sit beside Sword that drops the shield, spent whole by one exercise the holder priced as a gain.

status-conversions covers what one form of standing converts into and at what rate; power-trades covers what a power fetches when passed to another hand; this map covers only what an exercise consumes on the holder's own side without any conversion or trade, and each item adjacent to those maps says what it adds.

gaps: The changed question yielded spends whose register is not the counterparty's knowledge: a series that spends what no single exercise does (Pattern in the visits), a reserve spent by the holder's own principal seeing it (Slack shown to the budget), an exercise that is its own register and spends in proportion (Alpha spent by the trade), and two threshold spends where exercise is free until it is large enough to wake a rule-maker (Loophole with a name) or fund an entrant (Umbrella that funds the entrant), which the first framing could not hold because it assumed every exercise spends something. The territory pointer stands and the slug is kept; the of-sentence now sorts by how much exercise spends the condition and what must register it. The seriation's axis came from this: the itinerary runs from a spend total at a count of one, with no register but the holder's own, to a spend that needs an exercise large enough to summon the party that registers it, and the convergence at Pattern in the visits showed that the two ways of rationing a spend, moving and slicing, are the two ways of making the series that spends it whole.
accepted: Pattern in the visits: an advantage held in the unpredictability of an exercise is spent by no single exercise and by the series, as the surprise inspection that after four Tuesdays is expected on the fifth, the audit whose sampling rule has been inferred, the raid whose timing follows payroll; the condition spent is the target's inability to prepare, which becomes a schedule the target keeps better than the inspector does; it regenerates by randomization, which costs the holder its own planning and its staff's convenience; the mark is the site that is clean on inspection day and not the day after, a pattern the holder can see only by breaking its own; not Novelty in the book, spent by one recorded showing, since here each showing is free and the spend is a property of the sequence.

Slack shown to the budget: an advantage held in a reserve nobody has counted is spent by the first draw on it that a principal sees, as the surge beds staffed on an ordinary Tuesday that appear in next year's bed count, the contingency line spent on the schedule that becomes next year's schedule, the engineer's hidden week of buffer that the manager learns of and removes; the condition spent is the reserve's invisibility, which becomes a line item; it regenerates only by building a new reserve above the new baseline and hiding it better; the mark is the next budget, where the reserve appears as capacity; not Tolerance, spent by a target's adaptation, since here the party that takes the reserve is the holder's own principal, and the exercise is spent not by an adversary but by being seen from above.

Alpha spent by the trade: an advantage held in knowing where a price will go is spent by the trade that uses it, because the trade moves the price toward the knowledge, so the exercise realizes the advantage and consumes it in one motion and in proportion to its size; the condition spent is the price's ignorance, which becomes the price; it regenerates only with new information; the mark is the price impact, and the trader who sees it slices the order and hides it in dark venues to spend the condition slowly enough to collect more of it; the exercise is its own register, since no observer is needed for the spend and the holder wants it; not Umbrella that funds the entrant, spent past a threshold, since here every unit of exercise spends its own unit of condition and the holder chooses the rate.

Loophole with a name: an advantage held in a rule-maker's inattention is spent by exercise at a scale the rule-maker notices, as the tax structure that works until enough firms use it that the rule closing it carries the practice's name, as the anti-Morris-Trust rules carry the structure they ended, and the arbitrage across two regulators closed by a memorandum between them; the condition spent is inattention, which becomes a rule; it regenerates as the next gap, never as this one; the mark is the rule's name, and the practice taught afterward in the course on what used to work; not Umbrella that funds the entrant, where a rival is funded by the margin, since here no one competes for the gap and the responder is the party whose inattention was the condition.

Umbrella that funds the entrant: an advantage held in a sole position is spent by pricing to it, because the margin above the entrant's cost is what pays the entrant's qualification, as the incumbent supplier whose price makes the buyer's second source worth qualifying, the drug whose price funds the generic's patent challenge, and the sanctioned party's dependency, priced by the sanction into a payment rail of its own; the condition spent is the absence of a rival worth building, which becomes a rival; it regenerates rarely, and only by the rival's failure; the mark is the second name on the approved-vendor list and the volume it takes, which the incumbent will not recover by cutting price; the spend is a threshold, so exercise below the entrant's cost is free forever and exercise above it is fatal once; not walkaway-manufactures' Qualified on paper, the buyer's certificate, since here the certificate is read from the incumbent's side as the mark that the price went past the line.

residue.item: Sanction that teaches the target: the dependency used as a lever is rerouted by the target.
residue.why: Merged into Umbrella that funds the entrant as the case where the entrant is the target itself and the margin is the sanction's bite; marked speculative in the mode statement.

residue.item: Spent for everyone: a shared non-use, the taboo, spent for all holders by one holder's exercise.
residue.why: Held: the commons shape is already in Resistance bred, and the taboo case is speculative and adversarial-adjacent; kept as the longer-shot branch in the cross-field opening rather than as an item.

residue.item: Advantage spent by naming it: the tactic explained in the pitch, the method described in the paper.
residue.why: Merged: it is Told once seen from the holder's side, and Novelty in the book already carries the spend by the record; a description is a record the holder wrote.

residue.item: First sale: the seller's control of a unit is exhausted by the sale that pays for it.
residue.why: Held: in type and absent, filed in the boundary claim beside Sword that drops the shield; not admitted because the exercise is a sale and the map's other spends are not, and the author could not name what it adds beyond the doctrine's own statement.

neighbors.separating_case: One holder uses the same exploit against two targets on the same day. The first target images its disks after every incident, so the exploit is read from the image and patched within the month whether the intrusion took anything or not: spent by use. The second target keeps no logs, and the intrusion's only effect is a file deleted; if the deletion could be a disk failure, the flaw stays unknown and the holder can use it again, and if the deletion is of the one file only the holder wanted, the target infers a channel and hunts for it though it never reads the exploit: spent by inexplicability. A holder who cannot tell which target it faces prices the exploit as spent; one who can chooses the blind target and then spends by cover, which is why the two are one move apart on the map and two stops apart on the walk.

checks.boundary_case: The strike not run in twenty years, which returns at expiry as a threat the employer no longer believes, is a tempting nonmember and is out: it is spent by disuse, and power-trades' Leased strike carries it. Walk on record in walkaway-manufactures is the same power in the other direction, an advantage that regenerates by being exercised, and it too is out. The fence is direction: what exercise consumes is in, what exercise builds or disuse consumes is out. The one-use option, spent by exercise by construction, is out on the other side, since nothing beyond the option's own text is consumed; Never asked is in on exactly that contrast, since the ask is not one-use by any text and the count is a condition the record keeps beside it.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a convergence the walk conceals: Pattern in the visits is one stop on the itinerary, but two rationing strategies drain into it, the relocation that regenerates a Flaming datum and the slicing that spends Alpha slowly, so the two ways a holder has of spending a condition a little at a time are the two ways of making the series that spends it whole. It shows a passage between levels at Tolerance → Resistance bred, where the regeneration passes from the receiver's abstinence to the pathogen's fitness cost and the holder's restraint stops being worth anything alone. It shows a fork at Image shown down, whose two arms are whether the exercise works unseen: if it does the holder keeps a fold, and if the counterparty must see it to be moved the spend is automatic and becomes a Lever that tags the hand. It shows a step at Exception cited back → Never asked, where the first grant is priced like the first ask, so a walk that ends with exercises free below a threshold begins with an exercise for which any size is the threshold. And it shows an inversion at Ruling that prices the patent → Umbrella that funds the entrant, where the win that was meant to hold the position is what tells the entrant where the position ends.
checks.target_preserved: Self-read by the author, pending an independent critic: each item names a distinct spend, the condition, what it becomes, whether and by what it regenerates, and the mark; the author tried to collapse Tolerance into Resistance bred and could not, since one regenerates by abstinence and the other on the pathogen's clock; tried to collapse Lever that tags the hand into Image shown down and kept both on the fold; and kept the strange members (an advantage spent whole by a count going from zero to one, an exercise that is its own register, a win that draws the entrant's line, a spend registered by the holder's own budget) as mechanisms rather than domesticating them into signaling or into cost.

next_crossfield_opening: Spends that are shared: connect Resistance bred with cooperation-integrity-hinges and with walkaway-manufactures' Walk on record, and ask which conditions are a commons among rivals, so that one party's exercise spends the other parties' advantage too, the first suit in an industry where nobody sues, the first exploit against a vendor who then patches for everyone, the first use of a weapon everyone had agreed not to use; if such commons exist, the holder's restraint is priced by the least restrained rival, and the map's regeneration column needs a row for 'only by treaty'.

gaps: The register thread was misassigned at both ends of the walk, and at the closing hinge the misassignment was a false mechanism: Alpha spent by the trade claimed to be 'its own register, since no observer is needed', but lasting price impact is the other side of the book inferring information from the flow (the mechanical part refills), slicing and dark venues exist to hide the flow from readers, and the map's own edge to Pattern in the visits names a reader; at the opening, Never asked claimed 'no register but the holder's own count' while its own turnover clause makes the register the counterparty's memory, the same as Lever that tags the hand, which the neighbor test showed mirror-close on that ground. Both items survive with their registers named, and the axis survives read as the smallest exercise that registers: an ask of any size at the start, an exercise large enough to wake a rule-maker or fund an entrant at the end. Never asked and Exception cited back could not be collapsed (asker's record against grantor's discretion); no item restated status-conversions or power-trades.
accepted: Flaming datum: an advantage held in the counterparty's ignorance of where the holder is is spent by any exercise that can be traced, as the submarine whose torpedo hands the escorts a bearing, the sniper whose shot marks the hide, and the quiet acquirer whose first bid tells the market what it wants; the condition spent is the unknown position, which becomes a known one and a search centered on it; it regenerates by moving, at the cost of time and of the exposure the move itself risks, which is why the doctrine is one shot and relocate, and the acquirer, who cannot move, regenerates it only by bidding through a hand the market does not yet know is its own; the mark is the return fire, or in the market the price of everything the acquirer is now known to want; not Burned source, where what is spent is the counterparty's channel and no move restores it, since here the holder regenerates the condition by its own act.

Alpha spent by the trade: an advantage held in knowing where a price will go is spent by the trade that uses it, because the trade moves the price toward the knowledge, so the exercise realizes the advantage and consumes it in one motion and in proportion to its size; the condition spent is the price's ignorance, which becomes the price; it regenerates only with new information; the mark is the price impact, of which the part that eats the book refills as liquidity returns and the part the other side infers from the flow stays, and the trader who sees it slices the order and hides it in dark venues to spend the condition slowly enough to collect more of it; the register is the order flow itself, read by whoever fills it, so the spend needs no record, no forensics, and no cover, only a counterparty on the other side of the book, and the holder wants the spend, since the spend is the realization; not Umbrella that funds the entrant, spent past a threshold, since here every unit of exercise spends its own unit of condition and the holder chooses the rate.
seed: The commons dimension the walk conceals. Three items spend a condition shared among holders, Resistance bred (susceptibility), Tier above (a signal's rarity among senders), and Loophole with a name (a rule-maker's inattention among users), so any holder's exercise spends every holder's condition and one holder's restraint preserves nothing, and only the first item says so. The ledger's own next opening points here: which conditions are commons among rivals (the first suit in an industry where nobody sues, the first exploit against a vendor who then patches for everyone), so that restraint is priced by the least restrained rival and the regeneration column needs a row for 'only by treaty'. A second thread the map points at and does not hold is the first-sale exhaustion the boundary claim files beside Sword that drops the shield, the one spend on the map whose exercise is a sale the holder priced as a gain.
